processing.background: Connected 7% flood-fill from the image edge removes the baked checkerboard without crossing the dark character outline.
processing.crop: 760x760+180+120 from the 1122x1402 source; trim; scale to 800px; center on a transparent 1024px canvas.

surfaceBoundary: The Host uses the PNG for its existing Dock/Cmd-Tab process and packages both resources. It does not register a new Dock entry, notification identity, Finder app, Launch Services bundle, signature or bundle identifier.
